purpose: Public manufacturer data captured for owner review. Values remain unbound to project stock, stage, configuration and approval evidence.

sources.title: Novocon Form Tie & Inner Unit product page
sources.observed_scope: Inner Unit B9 label with publisher tensile 20 kN; Inner Unit D12 label with publisher tensile 32 kN; Form Tie + Nut product length rows; washer dimensions and round-pipe clamp range.
limits: No complete Inner–Outer–End connection–Nut–Plate assembly resistance was published on the inspected page.
No effective tensile area, stiffness area, thread pitch/tolerance, proof/breaking basis, safety factor or test report was published on the inspected page.
The page does not identify the project's batch, lot, revision or installed assembly.

sources.title: Doka Ringlock brochure, technical information page
sources.observed_scope: Permissible standard axial loads by ledger spacing and 2.0 m lift-height diagonal bay-brace force table; brochure states γM=1.1 and γF=1.5.
limits: The tables are product/configuration-specific and do not prove that the project's Thai stock is Doka Ringlock.
The table is not a complete shoring-tower, U-head, Jack Base, joint, foundation or second-order configuration rating.
No value is copied into the application's resistance fields by this capture.

sources.title: Doka Ringlock technical information leaflet
sources.observed_scope: Tube OD 48.3 mm, wall thickness 3.2 mm, steel grade S355JOH, hot-dip galvanized; available standard and ledger lengths; DIBt Z-8.22-992 approval reference.
limits: These identifiers are catalogue/system information and are not a project material certificate or installed configuration record.
The leaflet does not supply the complete project shoring resistance model.

ringlock_public_values.demand_basis_label: Permissible loads as printed in manufacturer brochure

complete Form Tie assembly drawing and capacity/test basis
Ringlock configuration rating covering standard, ledger, brace, node, U-head, Jack Base and joint behaviour
